d: Albilad Holding Company · Jeddah, Saudi Arabia · Full-time, On-site

We are hiring an Accountant to manage day-to-day accounting for our logistics, equipment rental, and trading operations. You will take responsibility for cost center accounting, fixed assets, and the month-end close, and provide management with clear reports on the profitability of each business activity and project.

Cost centers and profitability. Set up and maintain cost centers. Assign direct costs, allocate shared expenses using documented methods, and report revenue, costs, and margins by business activity and, where relevant, by trip, job, or equipment unit.

Fixed assets. Maintain the register for trucks, trailers, and equipment. Record acquisitions, transfers, depreciation, and disposals. Distinguish capital expenditure from routine maintenance, reconcile the register to the general ledger, and investigate differences identified during physical counts.

Month-end close and reporting. Complete the close independently, including accruals, prepayments, and account reconciliations. Deliver the monthly income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow summary, and explain material variances to management.

Project accounting. Prepare monthly profit and loss reports by project. Where profit-sharing agreements apply, calculate each partner’s share under the relevant agreement, prepare distribution schedules for management approval, and reconcile payments and outstanding balances.

Day-to-day accounting. Maintain the general ledger, reconcile bank and cash accounts and customer and supplier balances, verify invoices against supporting documents, follow up on overdue receivables, and prepare supplier payment schedules.
VAT and e-invoicing. Reconcile VAT accounts, prepare supporting schedules for VAT returns, apply ZATCA e-invoicing requirements, and maintain complete records and approvals for audit and review.
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance.
At least three years of accounting experience, including at least two years independently handling the month-end close.
Hands-on experience with cost centers, shared cost allocation, fixed asset reconciliations, and financial reporting.
Practical knowledge of Saudi VAT and ZATCA e-invoicing requirements.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting software.
Working proficiency in spoken and written Arabic and English.
Experience with Zoho Books or in logistics, equipment rental, trading, or a company with multiple business activities.
Familiarity with IFRS and Zakat filing, or a professional qualification such as SOCPA, CMA, or CPA.

Integrity, honesty, and accountability are essential. You are expected to protect confidential financial information, maintain records that can be independently verified, and promptly report errors, discrepancies, or irregular transactions.
Apply through LinkedIn with your updated CV. Highlight the work you personally handled in cost allocation, fixed asset reconciliations, and month-end closing.
Join Our Front Office Team as a Guest Service Agent at the First Vignette Collection in KSA!

We are looking for a welcoming, energetic, and detail-oriented Guest Service Agent to be the first point of contact and the face of the First Vignette Collection in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (Carlton Al Moaibed Hotel). Attributes: A genuine passion for delivering exceptional customer service, a high level of empathy, and strong problem-solving skills.
